name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Banyan Beef Skewer (Hot & Spicy Chili Sauce)
whyItWorks: Uses the same lean beef as the Bengal skewer, but the Banyan glaze is loaded with fiery cayenne and red chili paste that directly stimulates gut TRPV1 pain receptors.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Swap to the sweet Bengal Beef Skewer or ask for an un-sauced plain grilled beef skewer.
watchOuts: High capsaicin chili heat—avoid during flares or sensitive days
